Name: Ankh-Reaver of the Dawn
Description: Appearance: A blade of polished aurichalcum, etched with hieroglyphic sun-prayers. The fuller glows like molten gold when undead are near. The pommel is a miniature ankh whose loop burns with inner daylight. LEVEL-BASED PROGRESSION: Level 5 - Dawn's First Breath: The blade awakens with a soft, steady glow. Weapon Stats: +1 holy longsword, Deals +1d6 radiant to undead Passive:  Sun-Sense: Detect undead within 30 ft. Radiant Pulse (1/Hour): Heal an ally 1d6 or deal 1d6 radiant to undead on touch. Active (1/day): Solar Cut: +1d6 radiant; undead must save or be dazzled 1 round. Level 8 - Light of the Ankh

Name: Boots of Spider Climb
Description: When worn, these soft, lightweight boots let the wearer move along vertical surfaces or even crawl upside-down across ceilings, all while keeping their hands free. They function like a continuous spider climb effect with a fixed movement rate. Movement: 15 ft. while climbing per round. Limitations: Do not function on extremely slippery surfaces: Icy, Oiled, Greased

Name: Concelus Dawn Seeker
Description: Forged in the Sevenfold Sunrise ritual, this armor awakens as its wearer proves worthy. Its hieroglyphs glow brighter with each victory over undeath. Base Armor: +1 Radiant Full Plate. Aura: Strong abjuration & evocation Scaling: Unlocks powers at specific paladin levels. Level-Based Progression: Level 1-4: Dawn-Touched Aegis: Functions as +1 radiant armor, Constant soft golden glow (bright light 10 ft.), Undead within 10 ft. take 1 radiant damage per round, Wielder gains +1 sacred bonus on saves vs. undead abilities, Wielder gains +2 sacred bonus vs. fear. Level 5-8: Armor of the First Light

Name: Dagger of Whispered Venom
Description: A matte obsidian blade with a faint violet sheen. The hilt is wrapped in dark leather, and the pommel bears a stylized serpent coiled around a crescent moon. When drawn, the dagger emits a soft whisper only the wielder can hear. Venomous Whisper (2/day): As a free action before attacking, the wielder may invoke the dagger's venomous enchantment: Target must make a Fortitude save (DC 15) or take 1d6 poison damage and suffer -2 to attack rolls for 1 round, Undead are immune to poison but take 1d4 necrotic damage instead. Silent Edge: Grants +2 competence bonus to Move Silently and Sleight of Hand, When drawn, the dagger muffles ambient sound within 5 ft (non-magical only). Shadow Flicker (1/day): As a swift action, the wielder may teleport up to 10 ft to a space they can see, leaving behind a brief shadow afterimage. Must be used immediately after a successful melee attack.

Name: Elixir of Soul Renewal
Description: The Elixir of Soul Renewal (15th Lvl) restores deep soul damage, repairing both physical and metaphysical harm. Restores all ability damage to any ability score, Restores 1d4 points of ability drain (you choose which ability), Removes fatigue, Removes exhaustion, Removes negative levels (up to 2 temporary negative levels), Grants +4 sacred bonus on all saving throws for 10 minutes, Grants +10 temporary hit points for 1 hour

Name: Everfresh Picnic Basket
Description: Appearance: A sturdy, handwoven basket with a sun-motif clasp and soft linen lining. When opened, it emits a faint aroma of herbs and baked bread. The interior always feels cool and dry. Daily Meal (Su): Once per day, the basket produces a complete meal for 15 creatures: Includes bread, fruit, cheese, and a warm drink (tea, broth, or cider), The meal is nutritious, satisfying, and counts as a full day's sustenance, The food vanishes if not consumed within 1 hour. Hospitality Aura: Allies within 10 ft gain +1 morale bonus on saves vs fatigue and fear while the basket is open, Allies gain 1d6 Hit Points back after eating the meal, The aura lasts for 10 minutes after the meal is served. Flavor Shift (1/week): The basket can be attuned to a region or deity: Alters the meal's flavor and ingredients to match local cuisine or divine symbolism, Examples: desert dates and goat cheese (solar deity), mushroom stew and berry wine (nature deity)

Name: Handy Haversack
Description: A backpack of this sort appears to be well made, well used, and quite ordinary. It is constructed of finely tanned leather, and the straps have brass hardware and buckles. It has two side pouches, each of which appears large enough to hold about a quart of material. In fact, each is like a bag of holding and can actually hold material of as much as 2 cubic feet in volume or 20 pounds in weight. The large central portion of the pack can contain up to 8 cubic feet or 80 pounds of material. Even when so filled, the backpack always weighs only 5 pounds. While such storage is useful enough, the pack has an even greater power in addition. When the wearer reaches into it for a specific item, that item is always on top. Thus, no digging around and fumbling is ever necessary to find what a haversack contains. Retrieving any specific item from a haversack is a move action, but it does not provoke the attacks of opportunity that retrieving a stored item usually does.

Name: Helm of the Vigilant Mind
Description: A smooth, close-fitting helm of polished steel, engraved with a subtle pattern resembling an open eye. When danger approaches, the eye motif glimmers faintly. Vigilance (Ex): The wearer gains a +2 competence bonus on Spot and Listen checks. Danger Sense (Su): Once per day, as an immediate action, the wearer may gain a +4 insight bonus on a single Reflex save or AC vs. one attack. Mind-Ward (Su): The wearer gains a +1 resistance bonus on Will saves against mind-affecting effects (Stacks with a cloak of resistance because it's a different bonus type.)

Name: Lute of the Dawn
Description: Let the sun sing through your strings. A radiant instrument crafted from sun-blessed cedar and strung with threads of golden light. Its melodies stir courage, dispel shadows, and awaken divine memory.

Name: Mithril Chain Shirt +2
Description: Armor Bonus: +6 (+4 Base, +2 Enchant), Max Dex Bonus: +4, Armor Check Penalty: 0, Arcane Spell Failure: 10%, Speed: 30 ft. (no penalty), Weight: 12.5 lb., Type: Light armor

Name: Potion of Greater Vital Essence
Description: Drinking a Greater Vital Essence (11th Lvl) restores lost Constitution, both ability damage and ability drain. Restores 1d4+2 Constitution damage, Restores 1 point of Constitution drain, Removes fatigue, Removes exhaustion (downgraded to fatigue), Grants +4 enhancement bonus to Constitution for 10 minutes

Name: Potion of Vital Essence
Description: (5th Lvl) Restores 1d4+1 Constitution damage. Grants +2 enhancement bonus to Constitution for 10 minutes. If the drinker is undead, the bonus becomes +2 turn resistance instead

Name: Rope of the Clever Coil
Description: A tightly braided rope of pale gray fibers, each strand threaded with faint silver runes. When held, the rope feels warm and subtly shifts as if anticipating use. Animated Coil (Su) As a standard action, the wielder may command the rope to: Tie itself Untie itself Wrap around an object or creature Form a loop, harness, or knot The rope moves up to 20 ft. per round while animated. Grapplebind (Su) Once per encounter, the rope can attempt to bind a creature within 20 ft: Treat as a +8 grapple check On success, the target is entangled Escape Artist or Strength DC 18 to break free Rope takes no damage from struggling Sure-Hold (Ex) The rope can support up to 1,000 lb without risk of snapping. Memory Knot (Su) The rope can remember up to three knots. When commanded, it instantly shifts into one of its stored configurations.

Name: Shield of the Dawn Seeker
Description: A broad shield of aurichalcum and white-steel, shaped like a rising sun. The central boss is a stylized ankh whose loop glows softly. When undead draw near, the shield brightens like a sunrise breaking through fog. Aegis of the Dawn-Seeker (Standard Relic): +2 holy heavy shield, Grants +1 sacred AC, Grants +2 sacred bonus on saves vs fear, death effects, and necromancy, Undead striking the wielder take 1d6 radiant damage (once per encounter). PASSIVE ABILITIES: Radiant Bulwark: The wielder gains resistance 5 to necrotic (or negative energy). Sun-Ward Aura (10 ft): Allies gain +1 sacred bonus to saves vs fear. ACTIVE ABILITY (1/day): Solar Reprisal: A burst of dawnlight erupts from the shield. 15-ft cone, 2d6 radiant damage (Ref half), Undead take 3d6 and must save or be dazzled 1d4 rounds, Allies in the cone gain +1 AC for 1 round

Name: Solar Bastion of the Dawn - Shield
Solstice Aegis, Blade of the Dawnbound
Description: Scaling Trigger: Character level. Appearance: A longblade of polished silver-steel, its surface gleaming like morning frost. The fuller glows faintly with the light of sunrise, a golden hue that intensifies as the wielder's virtue deepens. From hilt to tip, spiraling runes etched in celestial script shift subtly with each level of attunement - radiant prayers that respond to divine alignment. The crossguard is shaped like twin wings of dawnlight, flaring outward in stylized arcs. The grip is wrapped in sun-blessed leather, reinforced with braided gold thread, and capped with a pommel shaped like a rising sun. When drawn, the air around the blade warms, and motes of light drift from its edge like dust caught in morning rays. LEVEL-BASED PROGRESSION: Level 5 - Dormant Light: The sword has awakened but remains gentle, like the first rays of dawn. Weapon Stats: +1 holy longsword, +1d6 radiant vs evil. Passive Abilities: Aura of Courage (5 ft): allies +1 vs fear, Radiant Touch: heal 1d8 once per short rest. Active (1/day): Sunflare Strike: On hit, +1d6 radiant; target saves or is dazzled 1 round. Level 8 - Awakened Dawn.

Name: Staff of the Dawn-Rebuker
Description: Description: A radiant quarterstaff forged from pale sunwood and banded with golden aurichalcum veins. The shaft is smooth but etched with faint, glowing script - solar prayers and necromantic wards written in a forgotten dialect of the Dawn-Seeker order. These runes shimmer softly in daylight and pulse with intensity when undead draw near. The upper third of the staff flares into a stylized sunburst cage, within which floats a crystal of dawnfire - a semi-transparent orb that glows with inner light. When the staff is activated, this orb emits radiant pulses that ripple outward like solar flares. Near the grip, the staff bears a radiant reservoir: a cluster of embedded sunstones that dim or brighten depending on how many charges remain. The grip itself is wrapped in braided leather from a desert lion, reinforced with silver thread and capped with a miniature ankh pommel, symbolizing divine rebuke and radiant judgment. When wielded in battle, the staff leaves faint trails of light with each swing, and its spells manifest as beams, bursts, or waves of golden energy. Undead struck by its Radiant Spark recoil as if scorched by sunlight, and necromantic effects flicker and fade under its influence. Level-Based Progression: Level 5 - Dormant State: +1 quarterstaff. Sun-Sense: Glows softly when undead are within 60 ft. Radiant Spark: 1/day, deal 1d8 radiant to undead on melee hit. Spell Charges (30): Disrupt Undead (1 charge), Light (at will), Level 8 - Awakened State.

Name: Sun-Sigil Brooch
Description: Appearance: A polished gold brooch shaped like a miniature sun-disc with an ankh at its center. The rays are etched with tiny hieroglyphic prayers. Passive Effects: +1 sacred bonus to AC, +2 sacred bonus on saves vs fear, death effects, and necromancy, Undead within 10 ft take 1 radiant damage at the start of your turn. Emits soft light (10 ft) when undead are within 30 ft. Radiant Safeguard (1/day): As an immediate action when you are struck by an undead creature: Reduce the damage by 5, your AC increases +2 for 4 rounds vs undead. Solar Mandate (1/day): A burst of divine authority radiates outward, 20-ft radius, 3 rounds: Allies gain +2 sacred bonus to attack rolls and saving throws, Undead suffer -2 to attack rolls, saves, and turn resistance, Magical darkness up to 3rd level is dispelled

Name: Sunstone Dawn Choir Bead
Description: Description: A Sunstone is a divine focus crystal infused with the essence of dawn. Crafted by priests of Ra, Horus, Seeker, and Concelus, these beads are sacred tools used to combat undead corruption and restore balance to the world. Each bead is polished to a warm amber glow, etched with solar glyphs and sacred hieroglyphs that shimmer faintly in sunlight. When activated, the bead emits a resonant chime - a harmonic pulse that echoes the celestial music of sunrise. This sound bolsters allies and weakens undead, pushing back the veil of darkness with radiant force. Effect: Once per day, emit a resonant chime that grants allies within 20 ft: +1 attack, +1 saves, Duration: 3 rounds, Bonus: Undead must save or take -1 to Will saves for 1 round.
